_comment: Deploy MY agent to Railway — a real, reachable service from an agent.yaml.
This runs YOUR agent (the one in your agent.yaml), NOT Himmy Studio (the admin GUI).
It builds the thin agent Dockerfile (`himmy deploy --docker > Dockerfile`), which layers
your agent.yaml onto the published runtime image ghcr.io/nlethetech/himmy — no framework
checkout. Commit this as railway.json next to your agent.yaml + Dockerfile.
SECURITY: the agent webhook stays signature-verified + default-DENY. The start command
binds 0.0.0.0 so Railway's edge can reach it, so auth is REQUIRED first — set these as
Railway variables BEFORE the first deploy (create_app refuses 0.0.0.0 with no auth):
HIMMY_API_KEY=himmy_<generate one>   # himmy seeds the keys file from this on boot,
OPENROUTER_API_KEY=...   # whatever your tool packs need
Run the worker (routine scheduler + run-queue dispatcher) as a SECOND service in the same
